description: Screening estimate of what a battery of a given size would have earned at an ERCOT settlement point (or the resource node nearest an address or lat/lng) over the last 12 complete months: day-ahead energy arbitrage from the node's monthly top-N minus bottom-N hour spreads (duration set by MWh divided by MW, RTE loss costed at the monthly average price, cycles beyond one valued at half), plus ancillary capacity revenue on the share of MW you offer to AS (best of RegUp, RRS, ECRS each month, offered every hour). Gross revenue only: no real-time, no degradation, no opex, no ramp or state-of-charge limits, and DAM energy and AS are not co-optimized. A screening number, not a forecast. Free returns the annual total; Pro adds the monthly table and a comparison with nearby nodes.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

as_share.description: Fraction of MW offered to ancillary services instead of energy, 0 to 1. Default 0.

cycles_per_day.description: Full cycles per day, 0.25 to 2. Default 1. The second cycle is valued at half the first.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

mw.description: Power rating in MW. Default 100, 1 to 2000.

mwh.description: Energy capacity in MWh. Default 4 x MW. Duration is capped at 4 hours for the spread (tb2/tb4).

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point (hub, zone or resource node) instead of an address or lat/lng.

name: battery_revenue_estimate
title: Screening revenue estimate for a battery at an ERCOT node
